params.body:
## What

The preview site is deployed through the control gateway from now on (control v0.26.0), never with a Forge token on a laptop.

- `bin/preview` and `.forge-preview.example.json` removed (and the `.gitignore` entry for `.forge-preview.json`): they needed a Forge API token in `~/.config/hub-report/` on the operator's Mac, the one write credential a session's machine may not hold.
- The site tracks the fixed branch `preview`, quick deploy off. `node ~/Projects/.portal/hand.mjs preview --slug stocklistplatform-eu --repo stocklistdealer-eu/platform --pr 511` asks the gateway for one run of two steps: `preview.push` (the branch to the pull request's head, forced, only on that branch) and `forge.deploy` (the site's tokenless trigger URL, held in the gateway's secrets as `forge-deploy-stocklistplatform-eu`).
- `App\Support\Preview`: the bar reads "PREVIEW, abc1234, data van 16/09 04:00". The pull-request-from-branch-name logic is gone; the branch is always `preview`, so its name says nothing about the pull request and the bar does not pretend it does. The commit is what a reviewer compares with the pull request.
- `elixir.json` declares `environments.preview` (the project declares its own topology; Elixir reads only production and staging, so this is not measured); `hand.mjs preview` prints that address.
- `docs/preview.md` rewritten for the gateway flow, with the lessons of 16 September: Forge owns the `.env` (edit it there, then Deploy Now, because a change reaches PHP-FPM only after the reload in the deploy script); `APP_KEY` must be production's and complete (`base64:` plus 44 characters); the first copy before the first deploy; MariaDB dump flags. The `.env` section now says what must be filled (`APP_KEY`, `APP_URL`, `DB_*`, `PREVIEW_SOURCE_DB_*`, `SESSION_COOKIE`, `AWS_*`), what may be emptied (every third-party key except `AWS_*`, `NIGHTWATCH_TOKEN` empty so preview errors do not land in production's Nightwatch), and the seal: `OUTBOUND_IMPACT` empty above all, because the global webhooks (Hexon, Okasie, FlexLease, YourDailyDrive) would otherwise receive changes from the copied data as real; `OUTBOUND_ALLOW=flexlease,realgarant` may open the read half of the quote-only services so screens show real numbers; not `vwe`, `removebg`, `blurit`, `openai` (credits per call) unless testing them deliberately.
- `CUTOVER.md`: the one mention of `bin/preview` updated.

## Tests

`PreviewEnvironmentTest`: the bar test reads the commit and the data date on a checkout of `preview`; a new test pins that a `workbench/pr-488` branch name yields no "PR 488" and that `pullRequest()` is gone; a new test pins `environments.preview` in `elixir.json` and the removal of the script and the example file. 10 of 10 pass (`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter=PreviewEnvironmentTest`). The wider subset around the seal, the bar and the stamp (119 tests) has three failures that are the fresh worktree's, not this change's: `BuildStampTest` (a worktree's `.git` is a file), `IntegrationSmokeTest` twice (columns missing after a bare `migrate` on an empty database), `RealGarantServiceTest` (no `.env`).

## Owner, by hand (Forge)

1. Preview site: Git branch `preview` (create it from `main` first if Forge insists on an existing branch), quick deploy off.
2. Copy the site's Deployment Trigger URL; on the box as `elixir`, one line in `/home/elixir/elixir-secrets/control/forge-deploy-stocklistplatform-eu` (0600); from the Mac `deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh tokens` in the control checkout; then the grant and the release as `control/docs/preview.md` describes.
3. Review the `.env` against the new section 5 of `docs/preview.md` (`OUTBOUND_IMPACT` empty, `NIGHTWATCH_TOKEN` empty, `OUTBOUND_ALLOW=flexlease,realgarant`), Deploy Now.

Companion PRs: control (the kinds), elixir (the grant), portal (the capability), and `hand.mjs preview` on the Mac.
params.title: Preview through the control gateway: no Forge token on a laptop
